about: Size budget of the cmux NEXT nightly app, checked by scripts/cmux-next/bundle-size.py check. Caps are bytes: the 2026-11-12 NIGHTLY receipt (DMG 285197892 bytes, app 909.4 MiB, CEF 352218261 bytes, Resources/bin 219 MiB, MacOS/cmux 154 MiB, Pages 40.5 MiB, AgentPane 18.4 MiB) plus about 5% headroom. Lower a cap when a cut lands; raise one only with a reason in the commit. The nightly check is blocking. Plan: plans/cmux-next/bundle-size-DESIGN.md.

arm64-cef-on-demand.about: Chromium on demand (bundle-size-DESIGN.md section 6): the nightly with CMUX_NEXT_CEF_ON_DEMAND=1 ships no CEF; the app downloads the runtime pack. The 630000000-byte app cap is a conservative interim estimate derived from the full receipt cap minus the 370000000-byte embedded-engine cap, with about 5% headroom; ratchet it from the first complete on-demand receipt. pack_max_bytes remains 115000000 until that receipt (publish-cef-runtime.sh checks it).
